domain-information: A Pet Owner requests a pet sitter for a specific time period to ensure their pet is cared for while they are away
A Pet Owner provides detailed care instructions to communicate feeding, walking, and medication needs
A Pet Sitter reviews assigned pet care requests to prepare for visits and plan activities
A Pet Sitter visits the pet and logs updates to keep the owner informed about the pet’s wellbeing
A Pet Sitter coordinates with other sitters to handle overlapping schedules or emergencies
A Pet Sitter delivers a report at the end of the visit to summarize the pet’s activities and behavior
A Coordinator confirms bookings with pet owners to secure schedules and prevent double-booking
A Coordinator matches available sitters with pet requests based on experience and pet type
A Pet Owner makes payment for services to complete the booking and confirm the sitter’s assignment
A Coordinator sends reminders to pet owners and sitters to ensure visits occur as scheduled

associations.description: Pet Owner creates a Pet Care Request
Coordinator reviews and manages the Pet Care Request
Booking references the related Pet Care Request
Pet Sitter participates in Schedule Coordination
Pet Sitter creates an Update Log
Update Log informs the Pet Owner
Pet Sitter writes the Care Report
Care Report describes the Pet Care Request outcome

name changes: Pet Care Request -> Pet Care Appointment
Pet Care Request -> Pet Care Job
